content.instructions: An adjective before a noun takes an ending. After ein, eine, ein (and mein, dein, kein) the ending shows the gender, because ein alone does not: nominative masculine -er, feminine -e, neuter -es; accusative masculine -en, feminine -e, neuter -es. In the dative the ending is -en in every gender.
text:
